params.caption: 🕹️ Nintendo patches Switch 2 jailbreak as Ocarina of Time remake leaks to PC With the new Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake already showing up on PC, Nintendo has pushed a Switch 2 update aimed at shutting down the jailbreak behind it. A well-known dataminer says the patch makes mods and game dumping impossible again, though it may not be a complete fix. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 14:52 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ #NintendoSwitch2 #Zelda #GamingNews
